Lynsey Freiburger

Operations Manager

Lynsey joined the H&B team in 2023 with many years of experience in management and customer service. She manages the front desk, billing, accounts receivable, and human resources. Lynsey also oversees the daily flow of office operations, provides support across departments and contributes valuable input into the strategic direction of the firm. Outside of the office, she enjoys homesteading and cheering on the Chicago Cubs.
